grade_note.zh: 演示级：v01＝文献典型值系数（v0.1 已审计口径）；v02＝USDA 逐格氨基酸＋FAO 2013 原报告模式＋分项消化率（中值）。价格锚全部带来源日期；未计风味/工艺/包装（LP 是原料下界）。
grade_note.en: Demo-grade: v01 = literature-typical coefficients (v0.1 audited caliber); v02 = USDA per-cell amino acids + FAO 2013 original-report patterns + per-ingredient digestibility (mid-values). All price anchors date-stamped; flavour/process/packaging excluded (LP is a raw-material lower bound).

source_doc.zh: 《G2蛋白混配LP算例：营养等价的最低成本求解（演示级）》（2026-10-22，Python fractions 精确顶点枚举；本演示器用精确有理数单纯形独立复算）。v0.2 数据升级＝该文 §八阶段1 任务拉前：USDA 逐格、酵母蛋白、分项 DIAAS、FAO 原报告核对。
source_doc.en: G2 Protein-Blending LP Case (2026-10-22, exact vertex enumeration in Python fractions; this demo independently re-solves with exact rational simplex). The v0.2 data upgrade pulls forward that document's Stage-1 tasks: USDA per-cell values, yeast protein, per-ingredient DIAAS digestibility, FAO original-report verification.
